verdict.rationale: The evidence describes composition pipelines, managed resources, and compatibility with Kubernetes tooling. None of it documents a Crossplane capability for bulk operations across many items at once (such as batch apply, mass update, or bulk delete). Compatibility with existing Kubernetes tools is a host-platform capability and earns no credit, and composition is never described as a bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
